title: recover-P: (6,2) STNFS on a twisted C4 base field behind a run gate: expected work 2^113.571415097238

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g2-invert-g1 target, proof.md's algorithm (run gate, section 1, field-map.md, the GT core of proof.md, DESCENT.md, KERNELS.md, STORAGE.md) returns P with e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied nonidentity Q with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins under heuristics H1-H5, H-EA, H-X and H-FFT, at expected total classical work at most 1+(K/2^64)(2^114.9284704189+2^66) < 2^113.571415097238 dense-Fp12 units (C=20,000 instructions): an expectation over the challenge and the coins of the one attack on the one target, not a bound on every run. The attack first draws a 64-bit word u and stops as a failure (under one unit) unless u < K = 7201208159453235316, the least K with (K/2^64) x 0.999031 >= 0.39. Past the gate it succeeds with probability at least 0.999031, costs at most 2^121.911223217801 units (both logarithms metered at 2^121.9, the ECM split at its row) and at most 2^114.9284704189 in expectation (the two logarithms at their expected work 2^109.277, H5, and the ECM split at its expected work; the other rows at bounds that hold in every run; the record walk and the matrix size at measured means + 2 SE, H3, H4). Nothing is amortized over other targets or runs. Analytic exploratory claim.
